trends.rule: Too early = fewer than 10 days of data or fewer than 20 events in the line. ratings.limits: Apple does not tell an app who rated it, or whether a person rated after the system rating prompt. The prompt itself may not even appear (Apple shows it at most 3 times a year per person and decides when). So a rating can never be tied to a person here; only the timing lines up. Written reviews come with a date, storefront, stars, title and text, but no link to a user. Rating counts are the public US listing, read on every rank check; Apple's cached copy sometimes shows an older count for a few minutes, so each day uses the highest count seen.
